column1: 21558§pressure§ˈpreʃə(r)§His father's blood pressure is a little high.§他父亲的血**压**有点高。§
21559§conviction§kənˈvɪkʃn§The information led to the conviction of those who were found guilty of treason.§这些资料足以给那些叛国者**定罪**。§
21560§tranquility§træŋˈkwɪləti§Tom and Mary lead a life in the village in search of tranquility.§汤姆和玛丽为追求**宁静**而在乡下生活。§
21561§facilitate§fəˈsɪlɪteɪt§The new strategies have facilitated and improved cooperation and communication between management and staff.§新策略**有助于**员工和管理层之间进行更为有效的合作与沟通。§
21562§grand§grænd§the grand ceremonial buildings of Machu Picchu§马丘比丘**宏伟**的仪式性建筑§
21563§installment§ɪnˈstɔːlmənt§Each installment costs $1, and site visitors are given three options.§每**一集**需付费一美元，网站的浏览者可以通过三种方式支付。§

21564§acumen§ˈækjəmən§Sometimes, organizations with sound financial backing, good product ideas and market acumen underperform and fail to meet shareholders' expectations.§有时，拥有雄厚的资金保障、良好的产品理念和对市场**精准把握**的公司却表现不佳，不能达到股东们的期望。§
21565§dissertation§ˌdɪsəˈteɪʃn§What I'd like to do in this session is to give you the opportunity to ask questions on writing the dissertation.§在这节课，我想做的就是给你们机会就写**专题论文**进行提问。§
21566§heap§hiːp§The heap of boulders does not fill the space perfectly.§**成堆**的大块鹅卵石不能严丝合缝地填充这个空间。§
21567§blame§bleɪm§The British diet could be partially to blame for the increase in back pain.§英式饮食应为背部疼痛的加重承担部分**责任**。§
21568§frame§freɪm§The tall buildings have been made possible by the development of light steel frames and safe passenger lifts.§轻型钢**框架**和安全客梯的改良使得高层建筑的建造成为可能。§

21569§symbolism§ˈsɪmbəlɪzəm§I have been exploring how well blind people understand the symbolism behind shapes such as hearts that do not directly represent their meaning.§我一直在探索盲人对形状（如心形）背后的**象征意义**的理解程度，这些形状并不直接代表它们自身的意义。§
21570§ascribe§əˈskraɪb§The report ascribes the rise in asthma to the increase in air pollution.§该报告将哮喘的增加**归因于**空气污染。§
21571§abstract§ˈæbstrækt§Thus, we concluded that the blind interpret abstract shapes as sighted people do.§于是，我们得出结论：盲人与视力正常者对**抽象**形状的理解是一样的。§
21572§disruption§dɪsˈrʌpʃn§The accident on the main road through the highway caused widespread disruption for car drivers.§公路主干道上的事故给汽车司机带来很大**不便**。§改例句：high way 应为 highway
21573§self-esteem§ˌself ɪˈstiːm§Sam suffers from low self-esteem and it prevents him from pursuing his goals.§山姆的**自信心**不足，这阻碍了他追求自己的目标。§
21574§literate§ˈlɪtərət§Though nearly twenty, Sara was barely literate.§尽管快20岁了，萨拉却几乎一点**读写能力**都没有。§
21575§extinction§ɪkˈstɪŋkʃn§It's a mass extinction, and whether we will ever rebound from the loss is difficult to know.§这是大规模的物种**灭绝**，我们是否能从中恢复还是个未知数。§
21576§endanger§ɪnˈdeɪndʒə(r)§Navajo is considered endangered despite having 150,000 speakers.§尽管有15万人使用纳瓦霍语，它还是有**濒临灭绝**的危险。§
21577§perception§pəˈsepʃn§Your perception and mine are different from the perception of someone who speaks French, for instance.§例如，你的**想法**与我的想法跟那些说法语的人的想法是不一样的。§
21578§prediction§prɪˈdɪkʃn§A growing interest in cultural identity may prevent the direst predictions from coming true.§日益增长的对文化认同的兴趣可能会阻止最可怕的**预言**成真。§
21579§foster§ˈfɒstə(r)§The old couple have fostered over 60 children during the past ten years.§这对老夫妇在过去的十年间**收养**了60多名儿童。§
21580§ancestral§ænˈsestrəl§The family lived at Mary's ancestral home.§一家人住在玛丽的**祖**居里。§
21581§rekindle§ˌriːˈkɪndl§In New Zealand, classes for children have slowed the erosion of Maori and rekindled interest in the language.§在新西兰，面向孩子们的课程减缓了毛利语的退化，**重新引起**了人们对这种语言的兴趣。§

21582§revival§rɪˈvaɪvl§A written form is essential for this, so the mere possibility of revival has led many speakers of endangered languages to develop systems of writing where none existed before.§书写形式对这（语言的复兴）非常重要，这一线**复兴**的希望促使一些濒临灭绝的语言的使用者开始开发之前没有的书写体系。§
21583§inevitable§ɪnˈevɪtəbl§A further escalation of the economic crisis now seems inevitable.§如今，经济危机的进一步扩大化**在所难免**。§

21584§disenchantment§ˌdɪsɪnˈtʃɑːntmənt§Disenchantment with orthodox medicine has seen the popularity of alternative therapies in Australia climb steadily during the past 20 years.§过去的20年中，在澳大利亚，人们对传统医学的**失望**促进了替代医学的日益流行。§
21585§acupuncture§ˈækjupʌŋktʃə(r)§Acupuncture is a kind of Chinese method of treating pain and illness using special thin needles.§**针灸**是一种中医疗法，通过使用特殊的细针来治疗病痛。§

21586§loath§ləʊθ§We've had a tradition of doctors being fairly powerful and I guess they are pretty loath to allow any pretenders to their position to come into it.§我们的固有观念是医生一定非常强势，我想他们一定非常**不愿意**让任何觊觎者达到他们的地位。§
21587§orthodox§ˈɔːθədɒks§In many other industrialised countries, orthodox and alternative medicine have worked “hand in glove” for years.§在其他的工业化国家里，**传统**医学与替代医学已经紧密结合多年了。§
21588§popularity§ˌpɒpjuˈlærəti§There is an increasing popularity of organic food these days.§现在有机食品越来越**流行**了。§
21589§amplify§ˈæmplɪfaɪ§Let me amplify so that you will understand the overall problem.§让我来**详细解释**一下，这样你就会理解整个问题了。§
21590§reliance§rɪˈlaɪəns§Long-term reliance on sleeping pills is dangerous.§长期**依赖**安眠药是危险的。§
21591§nightmare§ˈnaɪtmeə(r)§Traveling on the bad mountain roads is a nightmare.§在崎岖的山路上旅行真是件**可怕的事**。§
21592§leap§liːp§The athlete tensed his muscles for the leap.§运动员绷紧肌肉准备**跳跃**。§
21593§conscious§ˈkɒnʃəs§Deep inside he was conscious that music was not his destiny.§在内心深处，他**知道**音乐并不是自己的归宿。§
21594§divine§dɪˈvaɪn§To early man, fire was a divine gift delivered in the form of lightning, forest fire or burning lava.§对早期的人类来说，火是伴随着闪电、森林大火或是燃烧的岩浆而来的**神赐**之物。§
21595§decompose§ˌdiːkəmˈpəʊz§Earthworms decompose the dung further to provide essential soil nutrients.§蚯蚓将粪便进一步**分解**，给土壤提供了重要的养分。§
21596§investigate§ɪnˈvestɪgeɪt§We must investigate and understand the link between environment and health.§我们必须**研究**并了解环境与健康之间的联系。§
21597§underneath§ˌʌndəˈniːθ§Each of the 900 pillars of this building can be individually jacked up, allowing wedges to be added underneath.§这座建筑的900根柱子都可以分别托起以便**在下面**放入楔子。§
21598§division§dɪˈvɪʒn§The study covered 500 clerical employees in four parallel divisions.§这一研究涉及四个平行**部门**的500名文员。§
21599§gamble§ˈgæmbl§Bob might show up on time, but I wouldn't gamble on it.§鲍勃也许会准时露面，但我不想**冒这个险**。§
21600§ancient§ˈeɪnʃənt§The ancient Greeks used lenses to concentrate the sun's rays on dry leaves to light fire.§**古**希腊人用透镜将太阳光聚集在干树叶上生火。§
21601§strand§strænd§There are three distinct strands to Sports Studies and you would need to choose fairly early on just which direction you wanted to follow.§运动研究有三个不同的**分支**，你需要尽早确定研究方向。§
21602§specimen§ˈspesɪmən§Anton is observing the specimen with a magnifying glass.§安东正在用放大镜观察这个**标本**。§
21603§motive§ˈməʊtɪv§The police couldn't find a motive for the murder.§警方未能找出这起谋杀的**动机**。§
21604§furious§ˈfjʊəriəs§The furious workers agitated for a strike.§**愤怒**的工人们鼓动罢工。§
21605§alternative§ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv§The coal industry should be abandoned in favour of alternative energy sources.§应该用其他的**替代**能源来取代煤炭业。§
21606§access§ˈækses§The students could access the Internet in the library.§学生们可以在图书馆**上**网。§
21607§exhilaration§ɪgˌzɪləˈreɪʃn§Many astronauts have testified that they experienced the exhilaration of weightlessness.§许多宇航员都证实他们体验到了失重的**兴奋感**。§
21608§inland§ˈɪnlænd§Today about 90 per cent of inland freight in the United Kingdom is carried by road.§现在，公路承担了英国约90％的**内陆**运输。§
21609§migrate§maɪˈgreɪt§About half the nation's 2,000 beekeepers migrate north to find more flowers for their bees.§在这个国家的2,000个养蜂人中，约半数人为给蜜蜂找到更多的花而北**迁**。§
21610§claim§kleɪm§Many people claim they feel better in negatively charged air.§很多人**称**处在富含负离子的空气中让他们感觉更舒服。§
21611§digest§daɪˈdʒest§Chemists were searching for a fat that could be digested more easily by infants.§药剂师们正在寻找一种婴儿能更容易**消化**的脂肪。§
21612§decipher§dɪˈsaɪfə(r)§The scientists use the techniques to decipher disorder-related genes.§科学家使用这些技术，成功**破解**了与（遗传）紊乱有关的基因。§
21613§extraordinary§ɪkˈstrɔːdnri§It's extraordinary that he managed to sleep through the party.§真**想不到**他竟然从聚会一开始一直睡到结束。§
21614§stale§steɪl§There was a smell of stale vegetables in the air.§空气中有一股**不新鲜**的蔬菜的味道。§
21615§tan§tæn§These shoes are tan, not dark brown.§这些鞋是**棕褐色**的，不是深褐色的。§
21616§impair§ɪmˈpeə(r)§The performance of divers will be impaired if they work in cold water.§如果在冷水中工作，潜水员的工作效率会**降低**。§
21617§inescapable§ˌɪnɪˈskeɪpəbl§The role of governments in environmental management is difficult but inescapable.§政府在环境管理方面担负的任务很艰巨，但这是它们**无法推卸**的。§
21618§adolescent§ˌædəˈlesnt§The adolescent always respects parents who admit their mistakes.§**青少年**往往尊敬能承认错误的父母。§
21619§associate§əˈsəʊsieɪt§People always associate noise with headaches, and for most of us excessive noise creates the conditions for a headache.§人们总是把噪音和头痛**联系**在一起，对于我们大多数人来说，过多的噪音是引起头痛的原因。§
21620§layer§ˈleɪə(r)§Between the islands there was a layer of soft mud.§在小岛之间有一**层**软泥。§
21621§cable§ˈkeɪbl§The street is blocked off because workers are laying telephone cables.§因为工作人员正在铺设电话**线**，所以这条街被封锁了。§
21622§wedge§wedʒ§The window doesn't stay closed unless you wedge it.§这扇窗关不严，除非用楔子**楔上**。§
21623§historian§hɪˈstɔːriən§Most historians of technology credit the Chinese with the discovery of gunpowder.§大多数技术**历史学家**认为是中国人发明了火药。§
21624§fancy§ˈfænsi§Maureen tiptoed around the room in her fancy shoes.§莫林穿上她那双**精致**的鞋，踮着脚尖在房间里走来走去。§
